name: Kazutake
source:
Known as the Wayfarer, he is also a member of the Ten-Demon Alliance. He has short chocolate brown-colored hair, green-colored eyes, and pale skin.

Kazutake is the most reliable out of all of the selectable characters. Being the eldest of the chieftains in the alliance, he is like a big brother who naturally maintains peace. He is also very gentle towards women. He is so perfect that you sometimes feel distant from him, but he shows his special side to you and no one else. 

Taken from Demon's bond wiki.
